module_summary: AXI-Lite slave RAM: single-word write and read channels with registered ready/valid handshakes access a byte-strobed block memory, with an optional output pipeline register.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Word memory written with byte strobes, read into rdata register.

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address, shifted to word index for memory write.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Write address valid, joins wvalid to trigger write.

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Write data stored into mem bytes.

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Write data valid gating mem write acceptance.

anchors.name: s_axil_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte write strobes selecting which bytes are written.

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: Write address ready pulse from registered handshake.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid held until bready.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Read address, shifted to word index for memory read.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Read address valid starting memory read.

anchors.name: s_axil_arready
anchors.why: Read address ready from registered handshake.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from rdata or optional pipeline register.

anchors.name: mem_wr_en
anchors.why: Memory write enable asserted when address and data accepted.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Holds memory read word until response accepted.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Optional output pipeline stage, disabled by PIPELINE_OUTPUT=0.

groups.name: Write channel control
groups.description: Accepts aw/w together, issues write enable and bresp.

groups.name: Read channel control
groups.description: Accepts read address, enables read, manages rvalid.

groups.name: RAM array
groups.description: Byte-strobed word memory with separate read/write indices.

groups.name: Read data output
groups.description: Read data register and optional output pipeline.
